Wichita Falls, Texas · stay

Hotels in Wichita Falls for cyclists

Places to stay in Wichita Falls when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the start, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: Hotter'N Hell Hundred.

Hotels in Wichita Falls for cyclists, listed

  1. Delta Hotels by Marriott Wichita Falls Convention Center

    $$$ · 306 Travis St, Wichita Falls, TX 76301

    Attached to the MPEC, where HHH packet pickup and the expo happen; 200 rooms, steakhouse on site, walk to the start

  2. Courtyard by Marriott Wichita Falls

    $$ · 3800 Tarry St, Wichita Falls, TX 76308

    Indoor pool and on-site dining; a short drive south of downtown near the Kemp Boulevard restaurants

  3. Hampton Inn at Sikes Senter Mall

    $$ · 4217 Kemp Blvd, Wichita Falls, TX 76308

    Free hot breakfast, indoor pool; near the mall and the Bike Stop on the south side

  4. Homewood Suites by Hilton Wichita Falls

    $$ · 2675 Plaza Pkwy, Wichita Falls, TX 76308

    All suites with kitchens and free breakfast; sits on Sikes Lake with a one-mile path out the door

  5. Holiday Inn Express & Suites Wichita Falls

    $$ · 5300 Kell Blvd, Wichita Falls, TX 76310

    Free breakfast and outdoor pool on the southwest side; a drive from the start, often cheaper on HHH weekend

  6. Best Western Plus University Inn & Suites

    $ · 4540 Maplewood Ave, Wichita Falls, TX 76308

    Budget-friendly with free breakfast, near Midwestern State and McBride's Steakhouse
